ledger.claim: POL-NS-01 is conjunctive, and this record breaks it at limb (d). The trip record shows status COMPLETED with cancellation_reason_code null, cancelled_by null and cancelled_at null, and a metered run from 15:12:50 to 15:34:40 covering 16.5 km from Changi T3 to Paya Lebar Square. Limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated by the driver with a RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT reason code at or after the dwell elapsed; no termination of that kind, or of any kind, ever occurred. No cancellation fee is therefore chargeable and the driver's claim fails at the fourth limb, whatever the other three limbs show.

The 4.80 SGD the driver seeks is 80 percent of the AIRPORT zone-class fee of 6.00, which is exactly the driver-compensation figure POL-NS-07 would produce. But POL-NS-07 pays that compensation only where 'POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it'. POL-NS-01 is not satisfied: limb (d) fails because the rider boarded and the trip was driven to completion. The fare breakdown's own derived money block agrees, computing driver_compensation at 0.00 under POL-NS-07, not 4.80.

There is no contested cancellation charge on the rider's ledger for any ruling to move. The fare breakdown itemises cancellation_fee 0.00 and waiting_time_fee 0.00 against total_charged 29.08, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00; the 29.08 is simply the metered fare for the trip the rider actually took (base 3.80 + distance 12.38 + time 6.10 + airport surcharge 6.00 + platform fee 0.80). The -6.00 difference published in the derived money block is the schedule fee of 6.00 set against a fee_charged of 0.00, and it records precisely that no cancellation fee was billed. The filing party's claim being unsupported on the record, POL-GEN-03 leaves the present state as it stands and the rider carries nothing for a no-show.

The measured dwell of 530 seconds does not, on its own, entitle the driver to anything. Under POL-NS-01 the minimum dwell for the AIRPORT zone class is a condition of a chargeable no-show fee, and under POL-NS-06 it is the floor below which a fee already charged is refunded; neither clause creates a waiting payment where the trip ran to completion and no fee was ever charged. The driver's assertion in his own claim that 'the rules say I get compensated for waiting beyond the minimum' and that he 'doesn't have to call anyone' cites no clause in this policy, and the ledger shows waiting_time_fee 0.00.

I disclose that the only traffic advisory in this bundle, EV-ADVIS-00618-01, is MISSING: it has no payload, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (BLOCKING). I rely on the absence only, not on any content. No kerb-restriction, enforcement, closure or accident advisory covers this pickup road, so POL-NS-06(i) has nothing to work with: no second in-geofence interval can be accumulated, and nothing in this record extends or supplements the single 530-second holding run already measured.

The driver met limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-01 on clean telemetry. The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-18T15:03:52, and the driver's device trace — a full-coverage 205-fix record at 10 s cadence with no gaps — places him inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius for 54 consecutive qualifying fixes, that run beginning at 15:03:50, two seconds before the arrived event. Under POL-NS-02 the AIRPORT radius is 150 m, and there are far more than the three consecutive in-radius fixes that clause requires, so arrival at the pin is proved, not merely asserted.

Limb (c) is met with 50 seconds to spare. The driver held position inside the pickup geofence in one continuous run of 530 seconds, first fix 15:03:50 and last 15:12:40, against a minimum dwell of 480 seconds for the AIRPORT zone class; and the clock is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the arrived tap, exactly as POL-NS-01 directs. The derived shortfall is minus 50 seconds — that is, a surplus, not a deficit.

The rider cannot retreat behind POL-NS-05. That clause's distance trigger fires only where the arrived marker sits more than 300 m from the pin, and the trace's single in-geofence interval in which the driver held position begins at 15:03:50, before the 15:03:52 marker; at the marker the driver's admissible position was inside the 150 m arrival radius and therefore cannot be more than 300 m out. There is no false-arrival event here, and limb (iii) of POL-NS-05 confirms that even a sloppy marker would not defeat a dwell that meets the minimum.

No shortfall exists for the rider to recover under POL-NS-06. The effective dwell of 530 seconds exceeds the 480 second AIRPORT minimum by 50 seconds, so the clause's full-refund route is closed on its own arithmetic without the driver needing to accumulate dwell across separate intervals. I disclose that the traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00618-01 is MISSING — issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0 — but this claim does not rest on it: no advisory-excused accumulation is required, so the absence affects nothing.

The clauses that would refund the fee and pay the driver nothing cannot run. POL-NS-04 limb (a) needs at least one locating or coordinating message from the rider in the chat log, and the chat log for this trip holds zero messages; limb (c) needs the rider's device within the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius for the majority of qualifying fixes, and it never is — 0 of the rider's 41 fixes qualify, his fixes sitting between roughly 249 m and 258 m from the pin throughout. With both limbs unavailable, the rider-exoneration route fails and nothing displaces the driver's entitlement.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming guard does not trip, and the schedule amount is the sum the driver has put in dispute. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 110 is 0.009, below the 0.08 rate, so both limbs of the check fail to bite. On the SGD 6.00 AIRPORT zone-class fee the 80 percent compensation rate yields SGD 4.80 — precisely the contested amount.

The driver does not stretch the record, and the tribunal should note what he does not claim. The trip record shows status COMPLETED, started_at 15:12:50, ended_at 15:34:40, cancelled_by null and cancellation_reason_code null. It therefore does not show the trip terminated by the driver with RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is not made out on this record. The driver does not ask the tribunal to read a cancellation into a completed trip. That is the one gap in his case; arrival, radius, dwell, the absence of any displacing clause and a clean anti-farming profile are all proved on weight 1.0 evidence above.

Nothing on either profile sends this case away from a decision on the merits, and both files are cited only for the tests the general policy names. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so neither POL-NS-09(c) nor POL-NS-09(d) fires; no abuse pattern exists on either side to justify holding the case back from a ruling.

ruling.explanation:
Driver — you did on the ground what you say you did, and I accept all of it. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00618, weight 1.0, 205 fixes at 10 s cadence, no gaps) places you inside the 150 m Changi T3 arrival radius from 15:03:50 to 15:12:40 — a single continuous in-geofence hold of 530 seconds against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum — and your 'arrived' tap at 15:03:52 follows the first qualifying fix, so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) and POL-NS-02 are met, and limb (c) is met with 50 seconds to spare (derived shortfall minus 50 s, i.e. a surplus). POL-NS-05 does not catch you: no false-arrival marker exists, and POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to work on. But arrival is not the case you have to make; a no-show is. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated by you with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT at or after the dwell elapsed. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00618, weight 1.0) shows the opposite: status COMPLETED, cancelled_at null, cancelled_by null, cancellation_reason_code null, with the meter running 15:12:50 to 15:34:40 over 16.5 km from Changi T3 to Paya Lebar Square. The passenger boarded and you drove him. No no-show occurred, so no cancellation fee arises, and POL-NS-07 pays you 80 percent of that fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full — it is not. The SGD 4.80 you seek (80 percent of the SGD 6.00 AIRPORT zone fee) is therefore not payable, and the fare breakdown's own money block (EV-FARE-00618, weight 1.0) computes your compensation at SGD 0.00. The anti-farming guard does not trip on your profile — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against 110 completed trips, a rate of 0.009, both below the thresholds of 4 and 0.08 — but that is moot, because the entitlement never arises. Your own submission concedes the point, noting that the record does not show a termination on a no-show reason code and that this is 'the one gap' in the case; I agree, and it is decisive. Your assertion in the claim that 'the rules say I get compensated for waiting beyond the minimum' cites no clause in this policy, and no clause in this category creates a waiting payment on a trip that ran to completion.

Rider — there is no contested charge on your ledger for any ruling to move. The fare breakdown itemises cancellation_fee SGD 0.00 and waiting_time_fee SGD 0.00 against total_charged SGD 29.08 (base 3.80 + distance 12.38 + time 6.10 + airport surcharge 6.00 + platform fee 0.80), payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd SGD 0.00. The SGD 29.08 is simply the metered fare for the trip you actually took, and the '-6.00' difference published in the derived money block is the schedule fee of SGD 6.00 set against a fee_charged of SGD 0.00 — a record that no cancellation fee was ever billed. Nothing is owed to you and nothing is recoverable from you for a no-show. Your account of the pickup (that you walked your luggage to the car and were told coming to the door was 'not my job') is consistent with a completed trip and is noted, but no clause in this category produces a refund or a referral on it.

Both parties on the subordinate routes: POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider here — the chat log holds zero messages and the rider's 41 fixes sit between about 249 m and 258 m from the pin, outside the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius, so limbs (a) and (c) both fail — but that route was never engaged, since no fee was charged to refund. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00618-01 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, therefore it can carry no fact and its absence is all that is citable); neither side needs it, because no dwell accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is required. No escalation trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; the artifacts do not contradict each other on arrival, dwell or presence; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and the counterparty dispute counters are both 0; the anti-farming check does not trip; and the deciding facts rest on weight 1.0 material. Referrals: none — no clause here (POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival record, POL-NS-07 escalation packet) produces one. The present state stands: the driver's claim is not supported and the charge stands as it presently is. Confidence 0.9, capped at 1.0 by the weight-1.0 artifacts (trip record and fare breakdown) that carry the deciding fact.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
